categories.main_business_segments: Bestechnic (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. primarily focuses on the research, design, and sales of intelligent audio and video SoC chips. Its main product lines include wireless audio chips, smart wearable chips, and smart home chips, serving AIoT scenarios with low-power wireless edge intelligent control platform chips. The chips are widely applied in TWS earphones, smartwatches, smart glasses, smart hearing aids, smart speakers, smart appliances, and other smart home terminals.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced multi-core heterogeneous SoC technology integrating CPU, audio DSP, 2.5D GPU, low-power display controllers, and embedded AI co-processors. It utilizes 12nm and 6nm FinFET process technologies for chip fabrication, integrating RF, audio, power management, and Bluetooth/Wi-Fi modules. Proprietary technologies include adaptive ANC noise cancellation, dual-mic call noise reduction algorithms, low-power Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth 5.4 with IBRT multi-point connection, and embedded neural network processors (BECO). The company operates under a fabless model, outsourcing wafer manufacturing, packaging, and testing to specialized foundries.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global mainstream Android smartphone brands such as Samsung, OPPO, Xiaomi, Honor, Huawei, and vivo; professional audio manufacturers like Harman, Anker Innovations, Edifier, and 1MORE; internet companies including Alibaba, Baidu, and Google; and home appliance manufacturers such as Haier, Hisense, and Gree. The primary end markets are smart wearable devices (TWS earphones, smartwatches, smart glasses) and smart home devices (smart speakers, smart appliances, whole-house intelligent control terminals).
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and multiple R&D centers in Beijing, Shanghai, Shenzhen, Chengdu, Wuhan, Xi'an, and Hangzhou. It also has subsidiaries in Hong Kong and the United States. Its customer base and sales cover both domestic and international markets, with approximately 46% revenue growth driven by global economic recovery and expanding consumer markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Bestechnic operates as a fabless semiconductor design company, focusing on chip design, R&D, and sales. It outsources wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing to upstream foundries and packaging/testing service providers. Thus, it is positioned midstream in the semiconductor supply chain, specializing in chip design and development without owning manufacturing facilities.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous innovation in low-power multi-core heterogeneous SoC technology, Bluetooth and Wi-Fi connectivity, advanced acoustic and audio systems, and smart wearable platform solutions. It invests heavily in R&D, with 25.27% of revenue allocated to research in 2023, focusing on next-generation 6nm chips (BES2800), adaptive ANC, dual-mic noise reduction, AI voice interaction, and integrated health monitoring sensors. The company also emphasizes talent development and stock-based incentives to retain core technical staff and accelerate product upgrades and market expansion in smart wearables and smart home sectors.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the direct sale and distribution of integrated circuit chips. The company employs both direct sales to end customers (such as device manufacturers and solution providers) and sales through distributors. Revenue recognition occurs upon delivery and customer acceptance of products. Additionally, the company gains investment income from financial assets and government subsidies, but the core revenue is from product sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Bestechnic is a leading supplier of intelligent audio and video SoC chips in the smart wearable and smart home markets, recognized for its strong brand influence and technological leadership. It competes with international semiconductor giants that have larger asset scales and broader product lines. The company differentiates itself through advanced low-power SoC designs, proprietary Bluetooth technologies, and deep integration with brand customers, establishing high entry barriers and strong customer loyalty.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 2.18 billion, representing a 46.57% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 123.6 million, with a slight growth of 0.99%. The company maintains a strong R&D investment ratio of over 25% of revenue and has a net asset base exceeding RMB 6 billion. Operating cash flow turned positive with RMB 469.7 million net inflow, reflecting improved sales and inventory management. The company has steadily grown since its 2015 establishment and 2020 IPO on the Shanghai STAR Market.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Bestechnic emphasizes its cutting-edge multi-core heterogeneous SoC technology, ultra-low power consumption, and integrated AI capabilities tailored for smart audio and wearable devices. Its proprietary adaptive ANC and dual-mic noise reduction algorithms enhance user experience in complex environments. The company offers highly integrated single-chip solutions with advanced Bluetooth and Wi-Fi connectivity, supporting seamless multi-device audio switching and high-quality voice interaction. Its strong R&D and patent portfolio, combined with deep collaboration with leading global brands, provide differentiated, high-performance, and cost-effective chip solutions for the AIoT market.
